import h5py as h5
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

lm_id = l*(l+1)+m

momentfile = '../data/Moments_500M_L30.h5'

h5file = h5.File(momentfile,'r')
Ilm = h5file['geo_mass/Adaptive'][()][:,lm_id].conj()
t = h5file['time_adaptive'][()]
correction = np.mean(Ilm[t>=400])
Ilm_bar = Ilm - correction
h5file.close()

rot_freq = 0.20878380853617037
Ilm_tilde = Ilm_bar*np.exp(-m*1j*rot_freq*t)

# plot real, imag and abs
plt.plot(t,np.abs(Ilm),label='|$I_{'+str(l)+str(m)+'}$|')
plt.plot(t,np.real(Ilm),label='Re($I_{'+str(l)+str(m)+'}$)')
plt.plot(t,np.imag(Ilm),label='Im($I_{'+str(l)+str(m)+'}$)')

plt.grid()
plt.title(r'$I_{'+str(l)+str(m)+'}$')
plt.xlabel('$t/M$')
plt.xlim(-5,80)
plt.legend()
plt.show()

# Plot before and after floor correction
plt.semilogy(t,np.abs(np.real(Ilm)), label='|Re($I_{'+str(l)+str(m)+'}$)|')
plt.semilogy(t,np.abs(np.real(Ilm_bar)),'--', label=r'|Re($\bar{I}_{'+str(l)+str(m)+'}$)|')

plt.grid()
plt.title(r'$I_{'+str(l)+str(m)+'}$ Error-floor Correction')
plt.xlabel('$t/M$')
plt.xlim(xmax=400)
plt.legend()
plt.show()

# Plot before and after rotation
plt.semilogy(t,np.abs(np.real(Ilm_bar)), label=r'|Re($\bar{I}_{'+str(l)+str(m)+'}$)|')
plt.semilogy(t,np.abs(np.real(Ilm_tilde)),'--', label=r'|Re($\tilde{I}_{'+str(l)+str(m)+'}$)|')

plt.grid()
plt.title(r'$I_{'+str(l)+str(m)+'}$ Rotation')
plt.xlabel('$t/M$')
plt.xlim(-5,140)
plt.ylim(ymin=1e-7)
plt.legend()
plt.show()
